description: This Java class defines a SwingWorker implementation named CopySelection2DWorker, which operates on a Table2D object to copy its selection and perform UI updates upon completion.

classes.name: CopySelection2DWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass responsible for asynchronously copying selection data from a Table2D object and resetting cursor states upon completion.

methods.name: CopySelection2DWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the worker with a reference to the Table2D object.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the copying of the selection within a background thread.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets cursor states in the associated window and the application frame after background task completion.
